title: Shape
description: One shape node: an object discriminated by its 'shape' member. The operator vocabulary is open — core operators are listed in x-known-values, component-contributed operators are namespaced '<component>:<name>'. Per-operator arity is specified in spec.md §4; the branches below cover the core operators only, because an unknown operator's members cannot be checked here (spec.md §3.7). Recursive: 'of', 'items', 'keys', 'values', and the members of 'members', 'entries' and 'alternatives' are themselves shape nodes.

shape.description: The operator. Open vocabulary; an unknown operator is a named failure, never an ignored constraint (spec.md §3.7).

example.description: A value this shape admits, and the value produced for this node unless a variant point or generator selects another. For 'equality' it is also the operator's parameter: the shape admits exactly this value. Carries bytes when tagged (see 'encoded'); untagged it is the natural JSON value (Engine Protocol spec §2.5).

encoded.description: Representation tag for 'example'. Absent means the example is its natural JSON value; 'base64' means it is the base64 of an octet sequence (Engine Protocol spec §2.4).

members.description: Member name -> shape ('object'). Members not named here are admitted and ignored unless a member is declared 'forbidden' (spec.md §4.3).

entries.description: Positional element shapes ('array'), or the shapes that must each be satisfied by some element ('contains').

items.description: The shape every element must satisfy ('each-like').

keys.description: The shape every key string must satisfy ('each-entry'). Absent means any key.

values.description: The shape every entry value must satisfy ('each-entry').

options.description: The literal values admitted ('any-of'). Values, not shapes — a union of shapes is expressed with 'one-of' (spec.md §4.4).

discriminator.description: Member name whose value selects the alternative ('one-of').

default.description: Names the default variant point of this node: an alternative name ('one-of'). Absent, the default is the lexicographically first alternative — never JSON member order (spec.md §6.1).

alternatives.description: Alternative name -> shape ('one-of'). Each alternative is an 'object' shape binding the discriminator to a distinct literal (spec.md §5.4).

pattern.description: Regular expression ('regex'), in the dialect fixed by spec.md §4.2.

format.description: Date/time format pattern ('datetime', 'date', 'time'), in the pattern language fixed by spec.md §4.2. Optional: absent means the operator admits any string parsing as ISO-8601 for its kind.

substring.description: Substring that must occur in the value ('include').

content-type.description: Content type the value's octets must be detected as ('content-type').

generator.description: Generator component reference and configuration (design 2.6), used where a value must be produced fresh rather than replayed from 'example'.
